# Feature screenshots

This folder is reserved for the README gallery. Add real screenshots here, then link them from the main README in feature groups. No screenshots have been added yet.

## Suggested filenames

| Feature | Filename |
| --- | --- |
| History Categories | `history-categories.png` |
| Updates Source Categories | `updates-source-categories.png` |
| Favorites and Browse style | `favorites-browse.png` |
| Linked Sources and Merge Chapters | `linked-sources.png` |
| Update Watch | `update-watch.png` |
| Panel crop | `panel-crop.png` |
| Chapter comments and replies | `chapter-comments.png` |
| Global Chat and GIFs | `global-chat.png` |
| Profile crop and photo viewer | `profile-photo.png` |
| In-app updater | `app-updater.png` |

Use consistent portrait captures, preferably PNG or high-quality WebP. Keep enough surrounding UI to explain the feature; crop emulator/desktop chrome when it adds no context. Multiple screenshots can use numbered suffixes.

Use demo names/messages/photos for chat screenshots. Do not publish private conversations, account addresses, Firebase documents containing credentials, admin passwords or hashes, signing details, or tokens. Do not add placeholder images or broken image links to the main README; add gallery entries when their real screenshots exist.
